title: Parliamentary Speech Finder: semantic search over German Bundestag speeches (GermaParl)
description: A retrieval-only research tool for semantic search over the plenary speeches of the German Bundestag (GermaParl, PolMine). Speeches are embedded with jina-embeddings-v4; a query is encoded with the same retrieval adapter and matched against a FAISS index, with year filtering. Results are similarity-ranked original speeches with no model-generated summary, and selected speeches can be exported as individual PDFs. Code only: no corpora and no embeddings are included or distributed. The public deployment serves GermaParl alone; other corpora the code supports are licensed material and are run locally, never published.
